title: OCR single-character misreads: cheap extra doubt signal (tesseract per-word confidence, number/symbol token checks, option parity) (REQ-0065)

design.summary: OCR single-character misread signals: tesseract TSV per-word low_conf (calibrated by a 0-false-alarm sweep, off by default unless it helps), token glyph plausibility, option_parity structure flag; refined route deferred; no AI or paid call

implementation.summary: 71.1/71.2 tesseract TSV per-word low_conf (floor 60 from a 0-false-alarm sweep, ocr_conf default auto), 71.3 token glyph shapes, 71.4 option_parity structure flag, 71.5 calibration harness; guard test allowlists adapters/pdf.py for the tesseract subprocess (list argv, no shell, pixels on stdin, timeout)
